a.text: Notice
1) Residents must comply with all regulations previously announced by the Military Commission
2) Must comply with all work safety regulations. No time off allowed whatsoever
3) Leaving your place of residence after 7 PM is strictly forbidden
4) Mourning Mayor West in any manner is forbidden
Acting Mayor of Brentwood
Freda West
I still don't have the seed.
Can we still have those flowers ready by next year's harvest festival?
I don't want my family's traditions to die in my hands...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Come in.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Good morning, Magdelene, *Burp*—

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Were you drunk last night?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Hehe, Old Henk and I... had a teeny tiny taste of the Mayor's leftover booze.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I'll let you in on a little secret, Mr. West had more than just fine wine brewing for the celebration! *hic*—

steps.name: Will
steps.text: —He was hiding a whole cannon behind our backs! The last time I saw one of those, it was the harvest when we were ten!

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I'll definitely invite you to a dance during the gun salute at next year's festival, Magdelene!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You're still really drunk, you know that?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I just hope that the flash powder hasn't gotten wet, with all the barrels it was stored alongside.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: It'll only be a few more days. Once we're finished with that bloody thing the devils are having us build, they'll leave us alone.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Then, when the time comes for next year's harvest festival, we'll get to celebrate the return of our normal lives all night long—

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Hm—When did you start hanging clocks in the greenhouse?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: It's a long time past the time everyone's supposed to gather to head to work. Are you skiving off work today?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: They won't notice a single man missing.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I'm getting ready to head there. I know there's a back alley behind your greenhouse that leads straight to the work site.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Strange, though. Them devils don't often loiter around here...

steps.name: Will
steps.text: The door's over there... I'll head there right now!

steps.name: Will
steps.text: See you! *hic*—

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Wait, Will! Don't open that door!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Watch out!

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Oww—Magdelene, did a flower pot crack my skull open?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Nothing happened...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: *sigh*, you're still drunk. The door outside is that way. I'll take you to the work site.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Right, I gotta remember to bring a bouquet to mourn Mr. West. It's a shame he didn't get to taste the wine he was brewing...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You didn't see the notice they put up today?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: What notice? *hic*—

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Never mind. Take this flower.

a.text: Brentwood has visibly deteriorated over the last few years.

Although Mayor West racked his brains to try to turn things around, his ideas all yielded little results. Though caravans once visited in droves, none of them are willing to visit this forgotten town any more.
Everyone has been suffocating thanks to the ever-approaching war and the worsening situation in Londinium.
Two weeks ago, all of us gathered at the top of the town hall tower and saw a Catastrophe cloud rising into the sky in Londinium's direction.
Mayor West hesitated for half a day, and gave up on sending a team to Londinium to find out what happened. There were only the rumors that 'war has broken out.'
It was only when the Sarkaz came that the town regained its former 'vigor.' They hired all of us with food.

Everyone scrambled to line up for work day after day, and gave everything their all in exchange of the limited food there is. We're all very industrious. In a few short weeks, the thing that they had us build is already starting to take shape.
With the promise of survival dangling in front of us, we strained to forget how Mr. West died.
If there's no one working the farms anymore...
Then what is the harvest festival that everyone is so looking forward to actually celebrating?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Will, they're coming this way. Wake up!

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Dammit, Will... I told you not to drink so much!

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Sir, this man broke the rules. I'll be taking him to confinement to reflect on what he's done.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Looks like you enjoy the power we've granted you, Feline.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: I... I just don't want anyone to break the rules we agreed on.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Hmph, I can tell you're trying to protect him. Childish tricks.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: You'd best remember how your unlucky father died.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: His Highness is willing to overlook your disrespectful attitude before. That alone is your greatest reward.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: What we need now are honest workers. It's that simple.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I... It won't happen again, sir. I swear!

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: That's right. Your legs should be shaking.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Don't worry. You'll live. If you were dead, I'd have to find a *Sarkaz profanity* to do your job.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: I'll keep an eye on him. I promise there will be no delays.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Better not be. I don't care who picks up his slack, as long as one of you does.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Not you.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Now get back to your posts. I don't want the boss to chew me out.

steps.name: Sarkaz Supervisor
steps.text: Scram.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Magdelene, please. Let me take care of him. He'll sober up in confinement.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I'm sober! I wouldn't dare fall behind on the schedule they set.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Wait till you can stand before you act tough. If you pass out at the work site, I won't be able to save you.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: *sigh*... I shouldn't have given you the keys to the warehouse yesterday.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Are these flowers... for me?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Hah, of course not.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: I got them to mourn Mr. West.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: You didn't see the notice I put out today?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: He had too much to drink yesterday, so...

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Sorry, Freda... I was only going to have a little sip—

steps.name: Will
steps.text: —but that bastard Tom started spouting nonsense. He says you're a haughty traitor riding the devils' coattails!

steps.name: Will
steps.text: We're managing to get by these days only because you kowtowed to the devils.

steps.name: Will
steps.text: Old Henk and I were proper pissed off. We challenged the bastard to some drinking games, but we got careless and didn't stop, *hic*—

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: What they think doesn't matter.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Never mind. Give me the flowers. Let me thank you in my father's place.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Maybe we could hold a ceremony for Mr. West in the warehouse he was secretly making his preparations in.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: The Sarkaz rarely go there.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Thanks, Magdelene.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: My guess is that you got the flowers. He's not smart enough.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: But you should go back. I just heard... a group of outsiders appeared in the village a few days ago. Not the dukes' army, but they are armed.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: The Sarkaz are afraid someone in town could help them. They'll start today's search ahead of schedule.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: So early?

steps.name: Will
steps.text: What is she running that fast for? Is she in a rush?

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: For your own good, I suggest you stop bothering her so much.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: She has her own troubles to take care of. Now go. Sober up in confinement. *sigh*...

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: My men saw you go to the work site, Gardener.

spans.text: My men saw you go to the work site,

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Do not exhaust my trust in you.

a.text: How can I get rid of him?
I hope he hasn't found anything.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: You hung up the clock I gave you.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Very good. That'll help you to remember your work hours and not to leave your post.

a.text: He's got mud on his hands.
Did he turn my daisies' soil?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I didn't give my subordinates permission to muck around with your greenhouse—

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Hmph, you might as well just search out in the open. No need to be so cautious about me.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Or are you trying to look for these?

a.text: Phew, good thing it's just those seeds.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: These seeds are not on my list of approved transactions.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I don't care how you got your hands on these, but I suggest you knock it off with the stupid ideas.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: From today onwards, we'll deal with any suspicious individuals directly.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Why am I even telling you this?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Anyway, you'd better stay in line. Don't do anything stupid.

a.text: It's so quiet, it's eerie.
Should I turn around and look?

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: I like the flowers you're growing, these 'roses.' We don't have them in Kazdel.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: There's a battle. I need to leave town, and I won't be back so often anymore.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: You must be happy about that.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: Send these flowers to my tent later, Gardener. This coin is my down payment.

spans.text: Send these flowers to my tent later,
This coin is my down payment.

steps.name: Royal Court Junior Officer
steps.text: One last word of advice. Don't go near the work site at the center of the town.

a.text: These scary men are interested in such fragile flowers?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Oh! My roses...

a.text: The white petals are stained in red blood.
Was his hand pricked by the roses' thorns?
He didn't feel any pain?
Weird Sarkaz.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Oh no!

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: It's safe now! Are all of you okay?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Phew—Free at last. It's such a tight squeeze inside!

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Easy. You were just about ready to fight him, weren't you?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I know we can't bring trouble so soon—

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Sorry, Rockrock...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: And...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: I'm Feist.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I didn't expect them to start looking so early today. I heard there's a group of... 'armed militants' outside the town.

a.text: The two of them look at each other.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We're sorry for all the trouble.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Magdelene, right? Things here are a little not like what we expected.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: The situation is a bit... awful, I suppose? But there's a surface-level 'peace' maintained here.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Do the villagers serve the Sarkaz?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock!

a.text: Although the face of the young man named Feist shows many signs of battle weathering, I can nonetheless see a fearless courage in his clear eyes.
Rockrock seems to be his partner. I can imagine the two of them fighting alongside each other.
It's been some time since I saw such zealous vigor in this town.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: It's not a problem. It's true... Our town is working for the Sarkaz. Normal for Rockrock to be having doubts.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You told me you were refugees...

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I'm guessing you must be more than refugees who escaped Londinium, seeking supplies?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Sorry about that. We didn't tell you who we were before.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We're with the Londinium Citizens' Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Londinium... But what are you doing here?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Hm, it's a long story, and we'll have time to talk more about that.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: But first, could you tell me what the Sarkaz are building in the center of the town?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Kal—Our consultant is worried about what's being built here. Feist and I have tried getting closer to the area, but the Sarkaz are guarding the place very tightly.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: We could only see a giant blood-red crystal.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: It's much bigger than all the other ones that we've seen in both scale and complexity.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You mean... the thing we are building here isn't unique to this place?

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: We believe this is one of the Sarkaz's combat Arts Circles, but Brentwood's might be more special than that.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Our forces are planning to strike this place. Our fighters are... not in the best of shape right now, but with your help—

a.text: War.
Ever since the news came that the dukes have made it here, more and more of the town's residents have been talking about that ever-distant war.
But they only ever let their imaginations run wild lamentably away from the Sarkaz's view.
They only ever boast in their drunkenness, that the dukes' fleets will follow the routes they whimsically draw on maps to save Victoria.
They fantasize about how the Sarkaz will run away from Brentwood as they shout their rallying cries.
But what exactly is war?
I can't see any of it whatsoever in this quiet, Sarkaz-controlled town.
I don't want to ever see it, either.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: The Sarkaz... are going to be leaving very soon. There's nothing that they could want in our town.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Feist, Rockrock, you two should be on your way soon. It's dangerous for outsiders to be here.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You can take the alley behind the greenhouse. The Sarkaz don't patrol that area.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Even though Brentwood isn't at the forefront of the conflict between the dukes and the Sarkaz... the situation here isn't normal at all.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Whether it's the change in the movement of supplies to Brentwood for the last couple years, the almost intentionally ignored geographical location, and the enormous Arts node you're building.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Where are these Originium crystals from? How did the Sarkaz come up with such a detailed plan in such a short time?

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: This is a little embarrassing, but we still don't know what exactly the Sarkaz are trying to do.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: That's not a good thing...

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Magdelene, if you could help persuade everyone to help, we still have a chance to stop them.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Even if it's just helping us figure out the situation of the Sarkaz garrison stationed here—
You can stop hiding.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Hello, Self-Salvation Corps.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: (Feist, the evacuation route we were planning to take is still open.)

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: (Let's see how this plays out. We can't give up on this chance to get them on our side.)

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: (If Dr. Kal'tsit's right, what the Military Commission is planning here... has to be extremely important.)

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Relax. I was just passing by, and thought I would thank my friend.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Magdelene, Will said he forgot to say thank you, and asked me to thank you in his stead.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: *sigh*... He's always had those unrealistic fantasies ever since he was a kid.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: (This doesn't feel quite right.)

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: (It sounds like Will is the drunkard who almost opened the cupboard we were hiding in?)

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: (Shh... Let's not get into that.)

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: *cough*... Freda, I'll leave these two Self-Salvation Corps members to you.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: Do you need me to fill you in on their situation?

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: No need. I heard everything outside.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Freda... the mayor—

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: The Mayor of Brentwood was my father. He's dead.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Fortunately... he's the only one who lost his life in this town so far.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: But I'm afraid I have to turn down your request.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: I respect your bravery to stand up against them... but I can't put all of the town's residents at risk.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: My father had the same idea, and he's already paid the price. Resistance would only bring unnecessary sacrifice.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: The Sarkaz camp is not far from the main entrance to the greenhouse. For your safety, please leave quickly.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Brentwood will take care of its own.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Peace doesn't come easy and... I... I'm afraid of breaking it once more.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Freda, don't you see the problem in that?

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: They made me a promise. They'll leave as soon as their plan is completed—

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: You trust the Sarkaz's word?

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: I have to.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Rockrock, let's go.

steps.name: Rockrock
steps.text: Feist!

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: Mayor Freda, we'll working in the surrounding area. We... We're waiting to rendezvous with our other teams.

steps.name: Feist
steps.text: If you need assistance or... if things take a turn for the worse, you can find us there. That's our promise.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Self-Salvation Corps...

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Magdelene, I...

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: No, never mind.

a.text: Freda and I don't actually know each other too well. She has always been fairly asocial.
If it wasn't for Will making all kinds of excuses to drag Freda here to buy flowers from me, I likely would never have even known her.
Perhaps, like everyone else, I would've seen her as a crazed lunatic who's slaving away for the Sarkaz and dragged everyone else into that along with her.
I could even have forgotten that she's the same age as me.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: You did save all of us after Mr. West gave his life.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Hmph, I traded everyone's freedom for it.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Someone has to be the villain.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: I'm too afraid to give up, even if it only buys everyone a small chance to survive.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: At the very least... the Sarkaz's leader here... the officer who comes to your greenhouse doesn't kill for fun like the Sarkaz in the rumors. And so, I'd rather keep things the way they are.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: To be honest... I don't know what I should believe myself.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Magdelene, I'm really jealous of you.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Please forgive Will's stubbornness. He's just being childish.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: I've never been mad at him.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Have you received the seeds I secretly bought for next year's celebration?

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: There were some setbacks, but I have them.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: That's good. Hopefully they will lead to the most beautiful flowers by the time the next year's harvest festival is here.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Father planned for this festival for a long time, and I don't want to see his efforts go to waste.

steps.name: Freda
steps.text: Please help me with this.

steps.name: Magdelene
steps.text: It's my pleasure.
